messages.author: d73691b565754184
messages.subject: Re: Grey screen when building and evaluating a model
parts:
Hi Andrew,

Please be sure that you have installed the ecospat package and the last version of Wallace (v1.1.3) on your machine. To check the package version, you can use packageVersion("wallace").

Let us know if this fixes the issue.

Best,
Gonzalo
